Approach

How I try to make work useful.

01

Start with the workflow

Understand where time, uncertainty, or repetition is actually costing the user.

02

Build the smallest useful system

Prioritise the core path, clear data flow, and a working interface before decoration.

03

Make the result explain itself

Use readable outputs, documented assumptions, and simple navigation so the work can be revisited.
